Card Q&A.a: It refers to the Digimon card placed from the hand as the bottom digivolution card.
Card Q&A.q: Does "the placed card" in this card's [Main] effect refer to the Digimon card with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in one of its traits placed from my hand as the bottom digivolution card, or does it refer to my blue Digimon?

Effect: [Main] By placing 1 Digimon card with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in one of its traits from your hand as 1 of your blue Digimon's bottom digivolution card, return all of your opponent's Digimon with the same level as the placed card to the hand.
Security Effect: [Security] Return all of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest level to the hand.
